mails.subject: A little more space for big ideas
mails.preview: The new workspace is ready. Take a look around.
mails.body:
Hi Jamie,

Good things happen when we make room for them.

We’ve put together the first look at our new workspace, and I’d love to hear what you think. A calmer place to focus, share ideas, and do our best work together.

A few things to explore:

  •  A fresh direction for the studio
  •  Spaces designed for deep work
  •  Little details that make a big difference

Take a look when you have a moment. Let’s catch up over coffee this week and talk through your ideas.

Alex

mails.subject: Design review · Friday
mails.preview: A few thoughts ahead of our next conversation.
mails.body:
Hi Jamie,

I’ve gathered our latest designs for Friday’s review. The direction is feeling good!

Could you bring your thoughts on the onboarding flow? I’d love to make the first few moments feel a little more personal.

See you Friday,
Sofia
